scope: Local-only review candidate; owner approval is required before publication.

coverage: Complete specialization role/set enumeration and conservative source comparison.

All catalogue choices, search/pagination, open elective selection and capability presets.

corrections: Narrow implicit grid minimum and nowrap badges caused real overflow. Scoped minimum-width and wrapping fixes preserve the type scale; current native/private checks report no overflow.

limitations: Unknown grades, official GPA, applicable catalog and admission/registration status are not verified.
